note: Each cell's encoded.js is the VM encoder's output for its source.js with default options, which draw no randomness, with the leading disassembly comment block removed (the committed corpus format). Regenerating with the same encoder revision reproduces the bytes.

cells.forms: one function per way a statement can end inside a function: return inside for, while and nested loops; a loop then a final throw; a throw inside a loop then a final return; a return inside a loop then a final throw; a guard throw then a return; an if/else then a final throw; each run with inputs that take every path
